staged-apexconnect-remote.name: ApexConnect Remote Engine
staged-apexconnect-remote.description: Dual-channel remote desktop & background management shell (MeshAgent)

installScript.windows: $m = "$env:ProgramData\ApexMSP\meshagent64.exe"; New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path "$env:ProgramData\ApexMSP" | Out-Null; if (!(Get-Service "Mesh Agent" -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue)) { Invoke-WebRequest -Uri "https://mesh.apexmsp.app/meshagents?id=4&meshid=ulSX8VuJN9hFinyXGPovEZ4o5ShNQY7AK06I94WuTLzN1AblKrSIrLVz9DZw8vib&installflags=0" -OutFile $m -UseBasicParsing; Start-Process -FilePath $m -ArgumentList "-install" -WindowStyle Hidden -Wait; Start-Sleep -Seconds 2; Start-Service "Mesh Agent" -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue }
installScript.macos: if [ ! -d /usr/local/mesh_services/meshagent ]; then TMP_DIR="/tmp/meshagent_$$"; mkdir -p "$TMP_DIR"; if curl -fsSL "https://mesh.apexmsp.app/meshosxagent?id=29&meshid=ulSX8VuJN9hFinyXGPovEZ4o5ShNQY7AK06I94WuTLzN1AblKrSIrLVz9DZw8vib" -o "$TMP_DIR/MeshAgent.zip"; then unzip -qo "$TMP_DIR/MeshAgent.zip" -d "$TMP_DIR" 2>/dev/null && [ -f "$TMP_DIR/MeshAgent.pkg" ] && installer -pkg "$TMP_DIR/MeshAgent.pkg" -target / 2>/dev/null; fi; rm -rf "$TMP_DIR"; fi
